product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 49968 FlexBrew Connected Single Cup Coffee Maker with Amazon Dash Auto Replenishment for Coffee Pods 40oz
features: Never Run Out of Coffee Again: The Hamilton Beach Connect APP is seamlessly integrated with Dash Replenishment to track your brewing and automatically reorder single serve coffee pods and water filters before you run out
Choose Your Coffee for Reorders: Pick your favorite single serve coffee pods from a wide variety of brands and flavors
Brew with Single Serve Pods or Grounds: A single serve pod holder and grounds brew basket are included.Do not immerse cord, plug, or coffee maker in any liquid
Removable Water Reservoir: Eliminate the need to refill the coffee maker each time you brew
Quick Brew Time: In about 3 minutes, FlexBrew makes a strong, great tasting cup of coffee and while saving energy since FlexBrew only heats the water when you're ready to brew
Select Your Cup Size: Choose from 8, 10 or 14 ounce brew size; the adjustable cup rest fits a variety of mugs
Easy to Use: No need to deal with the hassle of a programmable coffee maker, just select your cup size and brew strength
The Coffee Maker That Does It All: Whether you are looking for a K Cup pod coffee maker or drip coffee, the FlexBrew is a must have
Note: Please refer User Manual before use
description: Never run out of single serve coffee pods again. This smart coffee maker is integrated with dash, so it tracks your brewing and automatically reorders your preferred brand of single serve pods and water filters before you run out. If you are in the market for coffee makers, whether it is a K cup coffee maker or a drip coffee maker, the FlexBrew single serve coffee maker has it covered. This small coffee maker is easy to move, making it an ideal portable coffee maker. The FlexBrew is designed for those that want a great one cup coffee maker.
